note: shadcncraft.com — paid shadcn component/block library (268 registry items: 197 registry:block, 36 registry:component, 27 registry:ui, 4 hooks, 4 style/theme). One page per item, and the leaf slug is exactly the registry name (blocks are '<element>-<n>', components are '<name>' or '<name>-<n>'), so every template is a literal category path + {name} and the id is the registry name: 4 /components/pro-<kit>/{name} families plus 32 /blocks/pro-<kit>/<category>/{name} families, and /pages/{name} (one item, messaging). attach_only: pages without a twin make no item (0 new items). Left out on purpose: /components/official-shadcn/* (61 pages, shadcn's own components, none in this registry) and the 13 '<name>' pages under /components/pro-application that are family overviews of '<name>-<n>' items (avatar-upload vs avatar-upload-1); /blocks/pro-application/sales-marketing-dashboard/* (23 pages of an app template, none a registry name); /docs/*, /blog/*, /apps/*, /figma/*, /theme/*, listings. robots.txt only disallows /_next/static/ — no template matches it.
